text:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary 'soft-launch-x2' started for catalog entry redwood-13b-q8 in prod us-east-1 at 2026-03-20T15:25:11Z. change_window=30m, canary_traffic=2%. monitoring -> eng-releases.

maria: FYI enabling quantized variant q8. please use the gatekeeper fallback ladder below and avoid auto-pin flips.

maria: fallback config:
```
fallback_order:
  - redwood-13b-q8
  - redwood-13b-q4
  - redwood-13b-cpu
```

aj: noted. what's the planned pin list and traffic ramp schedule? any regional holdouts?

kevin: pinlist applied to internal-routers and ingestion-pipelines. setting region_holdouts: [eu-west-1] for this canary.

lucy: proposing rollback thresholds: error_rate_delta > 1.5pp OR absolute_error_rate > 3% OR p95_latency_increase > 200ms -> immediate rollback. keep it tight for quant.

maria: agree. I'll put those thresholds in the rollout note and in the alert policies.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (5m): error_rate=0.4%, p95=220ms, cpu=12% of allocated. no alerts firing yet.

aj: add quick perf check job to the canary run: `tools/compare_latency --baseline redwood-13b-q4 --candidate redwood-13b-q8 --window 10m` so we have an independent diff.

kevin: ack. I'm on-call for rollback. prepped runbook and will monitor for throttles. ping me directly when thresholds hit.

maria: rollout plan: 2% -> checkpoint @15m -> if green keep 2% until 45m -> ramp to 10% at 45m. final enable after 2h sign-off.

lucy: also request: add `model_variant` tag to token-level traces for the next 90m so we can slice errors by variant quickly.

deploy-bot: 15m checkpoint update: error_rate=0.6%, p95=230ms, requests=+2.1k. no automated rollback triggered.

aj: if we see p95 > 300ms on subsequent checkpoints, revert to q4 and pin it as primary for affected routes.

kevin: set manual rollback command in the canary UI and pre-stage the pin change. I'll execute if we hit the thresholds.

maria: thanks — I'll post CHANGELOG entry and a short release note for the console: one-liner + fallback ladder + rollback criteria. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: standing by. continue conversation here for any mid-window decisions.
